item.title: City Leaders Deliver State Of City
item.description: Boerne Mayor Frank Ritchie, Mayor Pro Tem Ty Wolosin and City Manager Ben Thatcher gave the State of the City address October 29, covering the city budget, public safety, a sidewalk grant, Fire Station No. 2 and the Adler Road project.

item.title: Early Voting Day Eleven: Thursday Draws 1,277 Voters
item.description: Thursday, October 29 drew 1,277 in-person early voters in Kendall County, bringing the 11-day in-person total to 17,262, which the county puts at 41.79 percent turnout.

item.title: This Weekend in Boerne and Kendall County: October 30 to November 1
item.description: Weekend roundup for Boerne and Kendall County, Friday, October 30 to Sunday, November 1: 27 events, from Halloween festivals and trunk-or-treats to the German Motor Gathering and the farmers market.

item.title: Mail Ballots Accepted Rise to 848 in Kendall County
item.description: Kendall County reports 848 accepted mail ballots for the November 3 election, up 10 from the prior total, while the in-person early voting total stands at 14,614 through October 27.

item.title: No Hallmark Movie For Boerne
item.description: Boerne was one of 25 finalists for Hallmark's America's Merriest Christmas Town, but the title went to Carlinville, Illinois, which will be the backdrop of a 2027 Hallmark Christmas movie.

item.title: Early Voting Day Nine: Tuesday Draws 1,528 Voters
item.description: Tuesday, October 27 drew 1,528 in-person early voters in Kendall County, bringing the nine-day in-person total to 14,614, which the county puts at 35.38 percent turnout.

item.title: Chargers Win District Title, Volleyball Playoffs Set
item.description: Boerne Champion swept Alamo Heights for the 26-5A volleyball title, and Boerne High, Champion, and Geneva all have playoff matches on the schedule for Thursday, October 29.

item.title: Court authorizes sheriff salary grant application, forensic subscription
item.description: The Kendall County Commissioners Court authorized a sheriff's salary grant application of up to $350,000 and approved a $214,071.66 forensic software subscription at its October 27 meeting.

item.title: Boerne Farmers Market turns into Fall Festival tonight
item.description: The Boerne Farmers Market becomes a Fall Festival tonight, Tuesday, October 27, from 4:00 to 7:00 PM at 157 S Main St, with free entry, food vendors, crafts, a bounce house, music, and games for kids.

item.title: Early Voting Day Eight: Monday Draws 1,500 Voters
item.description: Monday, October 26 drew 1,500 in-person early voters in Kendall County, bringing the eight-day in-person total to 13,086, which the county puts at 31.68 percent turnout.

item.title: Court roundup: contracts approved, several items get no action
item.description: The Kendall County Commissioners Court approved a slate of contracts and appointments at its October 27 meeting and took no action on the space needs committee, the org chart, IT job descriptions, and the 714 High Street setback request.

item.title: Commissioners approve 2026 property tax levy
item.description: The Kendall County Commissioners Court approved the 2026 property tax levy roll totaling $44,778,256.64 on a 5-0 vote at its October 27 regular meeting.

item.title: Court closes out Corley Road Phase 1
item.description: The Kendall County Commissioners Court closed out Corley Road Phase 1 in four unanimous afternoon votes, accepting the work for maintenance and releasing a $2,338,076.20 performance bond.

item.title: Day Seven of Early Voting Adds 534 In-Person Voters in Kendall County
item.description: Kendall County's day-seven early voting report shows 534 in-person voters Sunday, bringing the seven-day in-person total to 11,586, which the county reports as 28.05 percent turnout.

item.title: Commissioners to weigh Corley Road closeout, Comfort setback request Tuesday
item.description: Kendall County Commissioners Court will consider Corley Road Phase 1 closeout items and a Comfort setback relief request on October 27, with a TxDOT update on SH 46 West set for November 10.

item.title: Court to discuss 120 acres near Comfort in closed session Tuesday
item.description: Kendall County Commissioners Court will meet in closed session Tuesday, October 27, to discuss a possible purchase of 120 acres near Comfort previously owned by the Hawkins family; the posted agenda names no seller and no price.

item.title: New Natural Area Nears Opening on Highway 46
item.description: The Albert and Bessie Kronkosky State Natural Area between Boerne and Bandera is targeting a late fall 2026 opening, with 28 miles of multi-use trail planned.

item.title: Day Six of Early Voting Adds 1,015 In-Person Voters in Kendall County
item.description: Kendall County's day-six early voting report shows 1,015 in-person voters Saturday, bringing the six-day in-person total to 11,052, which the county reports as 26.76 percent turnout.

item.title: The Man the County Is Named For Died 159 Years Ago This Week
item.description: George Wilkins Kendall, the journalist and sheepman for whom Kendall County is named, died at his ranch on October 21, 1867, at age 58. He rests in Boerne Cemetery under its only Texas Historical Commission marker.

item.title: Greyhounds stay perfect at 8-0 after pole fire delays homecoming win
item.description: Boerne High beat Veterans Memorial 49-7 on Friday for homecoming to stay 8-0, after a parking lot light pole fire at halftime delayed the game nearly two hours. Champion fell 35-24 at Smithson Valley, Comfort won 39-0, and Geneva beat Holy Cross 23-21.
